steps.title: Beginning Phase
text: Untap all your permanents, resolve upkeep triggers, then draw a card.

steps.title: Untap Step
text: Untap all your tapped permanents. No player receives priority during this step.

steps.title: Upkeep Step
text: Abilities that trigger at the beginning of upkeep go on the stack. Players may cast instants and activate abilities.

steps.title: Draw Step
text: The active player draws 1 card. The player going first skips this draw on their very first turn.

steps.title: Beginning Phase
text: Untap all your permanents, resolve upkeep triggers, then draw a card.

steps.title: Untap Step
text: Untap all your tapped permanents. No player receives priority.

steps.title: Upkeep Step
text: Abilities that trigger at the beginning of upkeep go on the stack. Players may cast instants and activate abilities.

steps.title: Draw Step
text: Draw 1 card from your library. The player going first skips this draw on their very first turn.

steps.title: Beginning Phase
text: Untap all your permanents, resolve upkeep triggers, then draw a card.

steps.title: Untap Step
text: Untap all your tapped permanents.

steps.title: Upkeep Step
text: Upkeep triggers go on the stack. Players may respond.

steps.title: Draw Step
text: Draw 1 card. First player skips this on their first turn.

steps.title: Main Phase 1
text: Play 1 land (once per turn). Cast creature, sorcery, enchantment, artifact, and planeswalker spells.
You may play up to 1 land from your hand per turn. You may cast any number of spells as long as you can pay their costs. Instants and cards with flash can be cast at any time.

steps.title: Main Phase 1
text: Play 1 land. Cast spells, including your commander from the command zone.

You may play up to 1 land per turn. Cast creature, sorcery, enchantment, artifact, and planeswalker spells. You may cast your commander from the command zone at any time you could cast a sorcery. Each time after the first, it costs an additional 2 generic mana (commander tax).

steps.title: Main Phase 1
text: Play 1 land. Cast spells, including your commander from the command zone.

Play up to 1 land. Cast creature, sorcery, enchantment, artifact, and planeswalker spells. You may cast your commander from the command zone. Each recast costs an additional 2 generic mana (commander tax).

steps.title: Combat Phase
text: Attack with your creatures and deal combat damage to the opponent or their planeswalkers.

steps.title: Beginning of Combat
text: Announce you are entering combat. The active player receives priority first.

steps.title: Declare Attackers
text: Choose which untapped creatures will attack and what they attack (opponent or their planeswalkers). Tapping the creature is part of declaring it as an attacker (unless it has vigilance). Creatures with summoning sickness cannot attack unless they have haste.

steps.title: Declare Blockers
text: The defending player chooses which creatures will block and how. Each blocking creature can block only one attacker. Multiple creatures can block the same attacker. A creature with flying can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach. A creature with menace must be blocked by 2+ creatures.

steps.title: Combat Damage
text: Attackers and blockers deal damage equal to their power simultaneously. First strike and double strike create an extra damage step before the normal one. Trample: excess damage to blockers spills over to the defending player. Deathtouch: any amount of damage destroys the blocker. Lifelink: you gain life equal to the damage dealt.

steps.title: End of Combat
text: Effects that last until end of combat expire. Creatures stop being attacking or blocking.

steps.title: Combat Phase
text: Attack opponents or their planeswalkers with your creatures.

steps.title: Beginning of Combat
text: Announce combat entry. The active player gets priority first.

steps.title: Declare Attackers
text: Choose which untapped creatures attack and which opponent (or their planeswalker) each attacks. You may attack different opponents with different creatures. Tapping the creature is part of declaring it as an attacker (unless it has vigilance). Creatures with summoning sickness cannot attack without haste.

steps.title: Declare Blockers
text: Only the defending player (the one being attacked) may declare blockers. Flying, menace, and other combat abilities apply normally.

steps.title: Combat Damage
text: First strike/double strike create an extra damage step. Trample, deathtouch, lifelink all function as normal. Commander damage is tracked separately per commander.

steps.title: End of Combat
text: End-of-combat effects expire. Creatures stop being attacking/blocking.

steps.title: Combat Phase
text: Attack your opponent or their planeswalkers with your creatures.

steps.title: Beginning of Combat
text: Announce combat. Active player gets priority first.

steps.title: Declare Attackers
text: Choose untapped creatures to attack. Tap (unless vigilance). Summoning sickness prevents attacking without haste. Attack opponent or their planeswalkers.

steps.title: Declare Blockers
text: Defending player assigns blockers. Flying blocks flying/reach. Menace requires 2+ blockers.

steps.title: Combat Damage
text: First strike/double strike extra step. Trample, deathtouch, lifelink apply. Commander damage tracked per commander (21+ = loss).

steps.title: End of Combat
text: End-of-combat effects expire.

steps.title: Main Phase 2
text: A second chance to cast spells and play a land after combat.
Identical to Main Phase 1. You may play a land here if you did not play one during Main Phase 1. Cast any remaining spells before ending your turn.

steps.title: Main Phase 2
text: Second main phase — play a land if you haven't yet, cast remaining spells, including your commander.
Identical to Main Phase 1. Play a land if you didn't in Main Phase 1. You may cast your commander from the command zone here if you haven't yet this turn.

steps.title: Main Phase 2
text: Second main phase — play a land if you haven't, cast remaining spells.
Play a land if you didn't in Main Phase 1. Cast remaining spells, including your commander.

steps.title: Ending Phase
text: End-of-turn effects trigger, then discard down to maximum hand size.

steps.title: End Step
text: Abilities that trigger at the beginning of the end step go on the stack. Players may cast instants and activate abilities.

steps.title: Cleanup Step
text: Discard down to your maximum hand size of 7 cards. All damage is removed from creatures. All 'until end of turn' effects expire.

steps.title: Ending Phase
text: End-of-turn triggers, discard to 7 cards max, damage removed from creatures.

steps.title: End Step
text: End-of-turn abilities trigger. Players may cast instants.

steps.title: Cleanup Step
text: Discard to 7 cards max. All damage removed from creatures. 'Until end of turn' effects expire.

steps.title: Ending Phase
text: End step triggers, discard to 7, damage removed.

steps.title: End Step
text: End-of-turn triggers.

steps.title: Cleanup Step
text: Discard to 7 cards max. Damage removed. Effects expire.
